lines.text: Reports in Ryze — ask, and it's built.
Reports in Ryze are made in chat. Just ask for what you need — a monthly performance report — and send it off.
The agent pulls everything from your real accounts — Search Console, Analytics, your store — and writes every page itself. You can watch the tools run right in the chat.

A few minutes later the report opens next to the conversation — a full deck. Keep scrolling: the score, what's working, what's not, and what to fix first. Every number in here came from your own data.
[warm] Want it live instead of a snapshot? Ask for a dashboard. Same numbers — but this one stays connected, so any day you open it, it's current.
Everything you build lands in Reports — decks and dashboards in one list, with status while they're being made.

[warm] Open any report, and it's yours to use. Download it as a PDF, or send it via email — straight to a client or your team. And see Update Report? That button opens the agent right here. Ask for a change — and the report updates live, in front of you.
[warm] And look — there are report templates too. Open Templates, hit Report, and pick one: monthly client decks, live dashboards, audits. One click, and the agent builds it for your data.
[warm] That's reports in Ryze. You ask, the agent builds — and it's all waiting in one place.
